text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000160 bills 99215 well above its risk-adjusted expectation in every complexity band, but the elevation is concentrated in multimorbid patients and the few returned charts support the billed levels, so the pattern is unresolved.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"Most of this provider's 99215 volume falls on patients with 5+ conditions, which points toward a sicker panel. Even so, the 99215 share runs above the all-provider share in every complexity band, so panel acuity alone does not explain the risk-adjusted excess. The heavy 99214 concentration in the mix adds to that concern. The documented 99215 claims are all supported at high MDM (e.g., C0094571, C0095218), but only 7 were reviewed and records came back for a very small share of claims, so the documentation is too thin to clear or confirm the pattern. The note signals are modest rather than damning: some late notes (C0095109, C0095218, C0096482), some repeated visit times, and one moderate-plus data claim without a lab line (C0095714). No audit trail was received, so cloned or templated notes cannot be ruled out. A reviewer should first request a larger, targeted chart sample of 99215 claims, including sampled low-condition cases such as C0094968 and C0096409. They should also obtain the audit trail to check note creation timing and copy-forward."}
